text:
incident-bot: [PAGING] Severity: P1 1: Model warmup errors and container crashes observed in ap-southeast-1 GPU pool. 18 model-load failures in last 3m, several containers OOM and crashing during warmup. Paging on-call.

alex: acknowledged. which model variants and which pool exactly?

incident-bot: Affected endpoint: /v1/chat.generate. Pool: ap-southeast-1-gpu-2. Error mix: model_deser_error, cuda_oom_compile, container_exit(137). Clients seeing 502/503.

riley: i'm oncall. pulling logs and node list. ken, can you grab the node health for ap-southeast-1-gpu-2?

ken: listing nodes...
- gpu-a12 (healthy)
- gpu-a13 (crashed, last seen 2026-03-15T02:10:22Z)
- gpu-a14 (high mem), gpu-a15 (restarting)

jamie: pasting a snippet from a failing loader log from gpu-a13:```
2026-03-15T02:09:58Z model-loader[pid=4781] ERROR deserialize failed model=rdw-2-xl shard=0: protobuf::io::error: truncated: expected 12345 bytes, got 8192
2026-03-15T02:09:59Z runtime[pid=4781] ERROR compile kernels for model=rdw-2-xl attn: timeout after 45000ms
2026-03-15T02:10:00Z cuda[pid=4781] ERROR failed to allocate 10.8GB for kernel compilation: free mem 9.4GB
2026-03-15T02:10:21Z container[pid=1] INFO Received SIGKILL (OOM) - exiting
```

sophia: dump indicates combined pressure from deserialization buffer and JIT compile. We pushed config earlier to up compile workers; was that region-specific?

alex: we increased compile concurrency globally last week to speed startup. might have regressed memory headroom. ops-bot: show config for ap-southeast-1-gpu-2.

ops-bot: config snapshot for ap-southeast-1-gpu-2: {"COMPILE_WORKERS": 4, "COMPILE_TIMEOUT_MS": 45000, "MODEL_PRELOAD": true} (retrieved 02:05:00Z)

maria: i ran an S3 object range check for rdw-2-xl/weights.bin: head shows size 24,576,000, md5 matches registry. full GET succeeded from another region. suggests local node read problem or altered streaming path.

jamie: could be an overlay FS issue where mmap returns short reads under heavy memory pressure. Also our recent glibc bump on v3.8 changed read buffer semantics. We saw similar in staging last month but didn't hit prod.

riley: mitigation plan suggestion: 1) reduce compile workers from 4->1 in that pool, 2) increase compile timeout to avoid mid-compile OOM aborts turning into retries, 3) disable MODEL_PRELOAD to reduce peak memory at startup for large models, 4) cordon most unstable nodes and drain slowly.

sophia: can do config patch: `COMPILE_WORKERS=1`, `COMPILE_TIMEOUT_MS=90000`, `MODEL_PRELOAD=false` for ap-southeast-1-gpu-2. I'll stage to control plane.

ops-bot: submitted patch request for ap-southeast-1-gpu-2 at 02:16:12Z. awaiting approval.

alex: while we wait, fallback options? we have rdw-2-large-q4b quantized available in other pools (us-west-2, eu-central). Can we steer traffic regionally for high-impact customers?

riley: yes, i can apply route split for customers flagged as tier-1. But we should coordinate with networking for cross-region latency impact. ken, can you prepare a list of impacted customers from telemetry?

ken: pulling telemetry: Peak impacted requests 14% of total gen traffic. Top impacted customers: Solstice Analytics (priority), Meridian Retail (priority), several small. Open support tickets: Solstice flagged at 02:08Z.

maria: ops-bot shows patch applied in 02:18:05Z. I'll start draining gpu-a13 and gpu-a15 and replace with fresh instances.

ops-bot: config changes applied. drain commands sent to gpu-a13/gpu-a15.

jamie: after config change i'm seeing fewer compile errors in logs on the patched nodes. crash rate fell from 0.9 -> 0.15 crashes/min. but two nodes still report truncated protobuf parse. collecting core on one for analysis.

riley: routing change: `cli route set /v1/chat.generate region=ap-southeast-1 --pct=60 --fallback-region=us-west-2 --tag=warmup-fallback` to send 40% to us-west-2. Applying now.

incident-bot: routing adjustment applied; 40% traffic cross-region to us-west-2.

alex: customer comms: draft for Solstice: "We're investigating elevated errors for chat generation in AP-Southeast. We've applied mitigations including routing to alternate region and reducing compile concurrency. Your traffic should see improved success rate. We'll provide a full update in 30 minutes." approve?

riley: send now. cc: support-sre.

maria: drained gpu-a13; container core collected. core stack:```
#0 0x7f2c protobuf parse_from_array+0x3b
#1 0x4b7d model::deserialize_shard
#2 0x2a1f loader::load_shard
#3 0x1f88 main::warmup_thread
```

jamie: running a local reproduce with dynamic streaming and non-aligned chunk sizes causes proto parse to fail with our current deserializer when combined with non-blocking reads under heavy memory reclaim. I'll prepare a small fix to align buffers on read and add retries on truncated reads.

sophia: also suggest we revert the global compile concurrency bump to the previous default for all pools while we vet memory usage under v3.8. We can ship a targeted perf improvement later.

alex: agree. riley, can you coordinate rollback of the global change? We'll do it staged: revert global change to default, keep ap-southeast patched until we validate.

riley: initiating rollback of global compile concurrency change. ops-bot: please apply.

ops-bot: rollback issued at 02:33:40Z; global COMPILE_WORKERS reset to default=2.

jamie: post-mitigation metrics: error rate in ap-southeast-1 for /v1/chat.generate dropped from 18% -> 2% over 12 minutes. cross-region fallback kept user-visible failures low.

maria: replacing two nodes gpu-a13/a15 with fresh instances and reimaging to v3.7.1 for loader to avoid stuck edge cases during warmup.

alex: handoff: jamie will own RCA and PR for deserializer buffer alignment and a small integration test for streaming reads. jamie, estimated PR by EOD. riley will monitor until 10:00Z. sophia will coordinate config rollbacks and revert temporary compile timeout extension after 30m of stable metrics.

riley: accepting on-call follow-up until 10:00Z, then hand to platform rotation. Marking incident mitigated.

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Incident ID: INC-20260315-AP2.

jamie: i'll draft postmortem timeline + customer impact numbers and include deployment correlation (glibc bump + global compile concurrency change). ETA postmortem draft: today 19:00Z.

alex: thanks all. closing thread, will post status page update and CS notes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: status-page note published: "Partial errors affecting /v1/chat.generate in AP-Southeast were mitigated by rolling config changes, draining unhealthy nodes, and temporarily routing traffic to alternate regions. We're continuing root cause analysis."
